verdict.rationale: Mintlify documents a first-party analytics dashboard that measures documentation traffic, search queries, engagement and reader feedback, which covers all three signals in the story, and the REST API can export analytics data. The evidence is only a one-line summary of the dashboard, and advanced insights appear to be Enterprise-tier, so the depth of the reporting is unproven. Missing for 10: documented per-page breakdowns showing which docs succeed or fail, detail on feedback and search-term reporting, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a DevRel lead, I see page views, search terms, and reader feedback so I know which docs work and which fail

citations.quote: Explore the Mintlify analytics dashboard to measure documentation traffic, assistant conversations, search queries, engagement, and reader feedback.
